statute_note: Principal source selected: LankaLaw consolidated HTML (statutes/HTML/22-1871-prescription-ordinance.html), chain to Ordinance No. 2 of 1889; the finalized tree is byte-identical to the canonical parse SRC071-22-1871.json before this pass's hand corrections. Other sources inspected: Legislative Enactments 1980 Vol. IV Cap. 81 (registry PDF, text layer, PDF pp. 270-272), used as the verification source and carried in the package; Government Printer PDF of Act No. 26 of 2014 (text layer, 3 pp), parsed with parse_amendment_pdf.py and hand-corrected. No copy of Ordinance No. 2 of 1889 is held. Consolidation cutoff: Ordinance No. 2 of 1889 (both editions). Review performed: one worker; section list (1-15) and chain header compared with the Cap. 81 print; word-level coverage of the tree against the Cap. 81 text (1738 words, 73 unmatched = 4.20%: front matter, running headers, letter-spaced OCR noise, 'hereinbefore'); s.15 read against the amending Act. Headings were not read one by one against the print; no Step 7 subagent rounds. Amendment coverage: 2 reconciliation rows; 2 of 1889 in the baseline, 26 of 2014 applied (one operation, recorded in applied_amendments_log and on s.15). Nothing applied twice. OCR or structural weaknesses: none from OCR (both sources have text layers). The compendium text layer is letter-spaced in places. Missing sources: Ordinance No. 2 of 1889 text. Unresolved questions: whether the Ordinance has been amended between 1889 and 2014 by any instrument neither edition lists (the LankaLaw regex-based marker scan cannot show a negative). The RUBRIK's 'Parsed from the HTML edition: 3 sections' line is stale (the parser fix that recovered ss. 4-15 is recorded in canonical-overrides.json) and should be regenerated.
